subject: Executive sign-off: 'Discovery Booster' trial uplift & discount combo for AeroGrid
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@aerogrid.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@aerogrid.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery Booster: Pilot uplift & pricing question

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the prototype with 3 internal teams and showed it to the procurement committee. Two asks came up that will decide whether we move to a paid pilot:

- We had unexpected delays getting access to our data streams; can we extend the pilot window by ~45 days so the teams can finish evaluation?
- Procurement is asking for a modest one-time usage credit to account for the integration time, and a small discount on Yr1 rates if we commit after the pilot.

I attached the updated SOW and a quick usage forecast. Can Redwood do a combined extension + credit to get us over the line? We have budget approval pending if terms are reasonable.

Attachments: Aerogrid_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF), usage-forecast.xlsx (Excel)

Would love to align today if possible — Samir
Senior Product Manager
AeroGrid
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@aerogrid.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery Booster: Pilot uplift & pricing question

Samir —

Really appreciate the transparency and the updated SOW. We can absolutely be flexible here and I want to propose an option that we can escalate for executive sign-off:

Proposal (subject to approval):
- Pilot extension: +45 days to the current trial window
- One-time usage credit: $25,000 applied to pilot consumption
- Contingent discount: 10% off list for Yr1 if AeroGrid signs a 12-month committed plan within 30 days after pilot close

If that sounds reasonable I will loop in leadership for sign-off and confirm any procurement requirements (PO, signature, etc.). Please confirm the PO contact for ProcureOps so we can prepare the DocuSign and the amended SOW.

Next steps:
1) Confirm PO contact / procurement timeline
2) I will request exec approval internally (cc'd Marissa & Ben)
3) We’ll send amended SOW and DocuSign link once approved

Thanks — Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACTION: Exec approval request — AeroGrid (DF-8742) combined trial extension + credit + discount

Team — quick ask for exec sign-off on a combined concession for AeroGrid. Context below.

Customer: AeroGrid (Samir Patel, Senior PM)
Deal: DF-8742, pilot currently in week 2 of 6 (delays due to data access)
ARR upside: $240k+ (expected if convert to committed plan)
Reference materials: Aerogrid_SOW_v2.pdf, usage-forecast.xlsx (attached)

Why this matters:
- Procurement needs a clear path to conversion; without softening the pilot economics we risk losing the deal to an incumbent.
- AeroGrid has executive-level sponsorship and a defined budget — they just need help accounting for integration overhead.

Proposed concession (ask):
- Extend pilot by 45 days
- One-time usage credit: $25,000 applied to pilot consumption (non-refundable)
- Conditional discount: 10% off Yr1 list for a 12-month committed plan signed within 30 days of pilot close

Risks / guardrails:
- Credit only for pilot usage logged during extended window; unused credit is forfeited
- Discount requires signed order and minimum 12-month commit; credit should not be applied to future invoices after pilot close
- Requires ProcureOps PO and signature (DocuSign)
Requested by: Laura Bennett (AE)
Suggested approval path: Aditya (Exec) sign-off -> Finance notified -> Legal to prepare amendment

Attachments: Aerogrid_SOW_v2.pdf, usage-forecast.xlsx

Thanks — Laura
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACTION: Exec approval request — AeroGrid (DF-8742)

Laura / team — reviewed the ask and the upside. Approve the concession with the following conditions:

1) Approve the pilot extension (+45 days) and one-time $25k usage credit.
2) Approve the conditional 10% Yr1 discount, capped at $30k gross discount.
3) Require a 12-month minimum commitment signed via DocuSign within 30 days of pilot close; if not signed within 30 days, the credit is clawed back as an invoice to AeroGrid (we will notify legal/finance to include a clawback clause in the amendment).
4) Procurement must provide a PO and authorized signatory before any credit is applied.

Please proceed to Legal to prepare the amendment and to Finance to flag for clawback monitoring. Laura — you can communicate approval to Samir and attach the DocuSign link.
Approved by — Aditya Rao
Head of Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@aerogrid.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@aerogrid.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 01 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery Booster: Pilot uplift & pricing question

Samir — good news: leadership has approved the combined concession with a few standard conditions. Summary below.

What we can do (approved):
- Pilot extension: +45 days to your current trial window
- One-time usage credit: $25,000 applied to pilot consumption
- Conditional Yr1 discount: 10% off list, capped at $30k, if AeroGrid signs a 12-month committed plan within 30 days after pilot close
Conditions / next steps:
- We need ProcureOps to send a PO and authorized signatory information before the credit is applied
- Legal will send an amended SOW with a clawback clause (credit becomes invoice if the 12-month order is not signed within 30 days)
- Please review and confirm the PO contact; once confirmed I will send the DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/exec/abc123
If you’re good with that pathway, I’ll have the amendment routed today and we’ll bump your pilot timeline once PO is received. Appreciate you and your team moving quickly on this — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.
Thanks — Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Aerogrid_SOW_v2.pdf (amendment pending), usage-forecast.xlsx
